research_question: What operational mechanism could have produced the explicit BPS revision of the Sumatera Barat construction series first confirmed in the Statistik Indonesia 2005/2006 vintage?

directory_update_2005.finding: The catalog states that the 2005 construction-establishment profile resulted from a construction-directory updating conducted simultaneously throughout Indonesia at the end of 2005. The outside-Java profile is based on the 2005 updating and presents construction-activity indicators for 2003-2005; its catalog entry also states that presented data result from the annual construction establishment survey.

directory_update_sampling_frame_use.recorded_data_use: Sampling frame kegiatan survei konstruksi sebagai direktori awal perusahaan konstruksi
directory_update_sampling_frame_use.artifact_access: BPS-authored publication accessed via mirror retaining bps.go.id markings

annual_survey_expansion_method_support.finding_directory: BPS describes construction-directory updating as necessary to obtain an up-to-date frame of incorporated national construction establishments with grades 2-7.
annual_survey_expansion_method_support.finding_sampling: The annual construction survey is described as take-all for grades 5-7 and take-some for grades 2-4.
annual_survey_expansion_method_support.finding_estimation: Population estimates for each characteristic use establishment qualification as the basis of the expansion factor.
annual_survey_expansion_method_support.temporal_limitation: This is documentation of the 2010 operational method and is not direct evidence that the identical expansion algorithm was used for the 2005/2006 historical revision.

revised_series_publication_environment.finding: The official catalog describes Statistik Konstruksi 2005 as an annual construction-establishment series through 2004 resulting from the Annual Construction Establishment Survey.

candidate_mechanism.hypothesis: The nationwide end-2005 directory refresh could have changed the construction-establishment sampling frame and qualification composition used in survey estimation, making re-estimation of population-level construction characteristics operationally possible.
supporting_chain: nationwide construction-directory update at end-2005 is confirmed
the 2005 updating output is explicitly recorded by BPS metadata as a sampling frame for construction-survey activity
an outside-Java profile relevant to Sumatera Barat explicitly combines the 2005 updating basis with annual-survey construction indicators
BPS later documents annual-survey population expansion using establishment qualification as the expansion-factor basis
the revised 2001-2003 series is first confirmed in the examined yearbook vintage immediately after the 2005 updating period
evidence_missing_for_causal_confirmation: a contemporaneous 2005/2006 survey manual stating that the refreshed directory replaced the prior frame for the revised historical estimates
a contemporaneous weighting or expansion-factor formula used to recompute 2001-2003
a revision note explicitly connecting the revised series to the 2005 directory update
old-versus-new frame counts by Sumatera Barat and qualification stratum sufficient to reproduce the revision
a reproducible bridge from old-vintage values to revised-vintage values

numerical_consistency.reason: A common scale factor is compatible with an expansion-factor change but is not unique evidence for one; component-level revisions are heterogeneous and no contemporaneous formula has been recovered.
